mentions.name: A2Fusion
mentions.description: A dual RP2350 expansion board for the Apple II that combines storage, HDMI video output, and other functions on a single card. The proof of concept is currently a hand-wired prototype, with first PCB prototype boards on order from JLCPCB.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building A2Fusion [1], a dual RP2350 expansion board for the Apple II to provide, storage, hdmi video and other functions in one card.  The PoC is currently a big mess of wires.  Waiting on JLCPCB for first prototype boards.
